title: Desert Muse at Sunset
description: A surreal desert landscape features a woman with closed eyes whose hair transforms into intricate green vines and blooming flowers. In the background, red sand dunes stretch toward purple mountains under a large glowing red sun crossed by a dark bar, with a red 'NO ENTRY' sign standing in the midground.
prompt: Surreal desert scene at sunset with a serene woman in profile, eyes closed, her flowing hair transforming into intricate green vines and pink flowers that spread across the foreground. Red sand dunes and purple mountains in the distance, a massive glowing red sun dominating the sky crossed by a dark horizontal bar, with a weathered red 'NO ENTRY' sign on a post nearby, birds flying in the distance, dreamlike and symbolic atmosphere.
